name: Major floods
summary: No GDACS flood alerts; Cyclone Murasu brings heavy rain to India's east coast
state: GDACS listed no orange or red flood alerts on 2 Nov. Cyclone Murasu is forecast to bring heavy rain to Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Odisha until 4 Nov after crossing the coast near Ongole overnight 2–3 Nov; officials expect 6,000–8,000 power poles could be damaged (Al Jazeera).
for_you: No major flood disruption to travel at present; check local warnings in south-east India.

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
Al Jazeera — Thousands evacuated as India braces for second cyclone in a week

why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
drivers: Extreme rainfall, monsoons, cyclones, snowmelt, dam failures.

rubric.alert: GDACS red flood alert, or > 100 deaths in a single event.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange flood alert, or a flood displacing > 50,000.
